key.name: playlist
key.description: Name of a playlist in ~/Videos/aerial/.meta/playlists/ (without .txt). Empty: the launcher default (.meta/default). Changing it restarts the wallpaper.

key.name: pause-when-covered
key.description: Pause the video while a fullscreen or fully maximized window covers the primary monitor. It always pauses while the screen is blanked.

key.name: overview-video
key.description: Show the live video as the workspace background in the overview instead of the static wallpaper.

key.name: widget-classes
key.description: Window classes (Wayland app ids or X11 WM_CLASS) handled as desktop widgets: kept just above the video and below every other window, on all workspaces, out of alt-tab, the overview and window lists. AerialConky is the extension's own Conky.

key.name: conky-enabled
key.description: Run the Conky panel (aerial-conky.service) while the extension is enabled.

key.name: conky-mode
key.description: generated: built from the conky-* settings. custom: the Lua config at conky-custom-path, with the window settings the extension needs layered on top.

key.name: conky-custom-path
key.description: Path to your own conky.conf, used when conky-mode is custom. ~ is expanded.

key.name: conky-position
key.description: Where the panel sits on the primary monitor's work area (inside the top bar and docks).

key.name: conky-margin-x
key.description: Pixels between the panel and the left or right edge of the work area.

key.name: conky-margin-y
key.description: Pixels between the panel and the top or bottom edge of the work area.

key.name: conky-width
key.description: Minimum panel width in pixels; also the width of bars and graphs.

key.name: conky-font
key.description: Pango font description, for example "DejaVu Sans Mono 12".

key.name: conky-color
key.description: Text colour as #rrggbb.

key.name: conky-accent-color
key.description: Colour of headings, bars and graphs, as #rrggbb.

key.name: conky-label-color
key.description: Colour of labels, as #rrggbb.

key.name: conky-background
key.description: Panel background as #rrggbb; see conky-opacity.

key.name: conky-opacity
key.description: 0 is fully transparent, 1 is opaque.

key.name: conky-interval
key.description: Seconds between updates.

key.name: conky-graphs
key.description: Draw history graphs for CPU and network; off draws bars only.

key.name: conky-sections
key.description: Sections shown, in order. Available: header, clock, system, cpu, cores, memory, gpu, disks, network, processes, aerial, custom.

key.name: conky-disks
key.description: Mount points shown in the disks section.

key.name: conky-interface
key.description: Interface for the network section. Empty: the default-route interface at the time the config is written.

key.name: conky-process-count
key.description: Rows in the processes section.

key.name: conky-custom-text
key.description: Raw Conky text for the custom section (Conky variables allowed).
